title: Which fold makes a line parallel to the diagonal?
description: A square sheet is folded along one diagonal. A corner is folded onto the centre, and the board shows that the new crease and the diagonal are both at right angles to the other diagonal, so they are parallel. Keeko doubts that the other diagonal is the answer.
teaching_notes: One idea: two lines at right angles to the same line are parallel, so folding a corner onto the centre gives a crease parallel to a diagonal. Watch for students who fold along the other diagonal, which crosses the first.

source: Fold a square sheet along one diagonal. Describe a fold that makes a line parallel to this diagonal and say why it is parallel.
video_script.why: The child finds a fold that gives a parallel line and gives the reason, using right angles.
video_script.substitution: The book's own paper folding activity: a square sheet is folded along a diagonal and the child looks for a fold that creates a line parallel to it.
video_script.anchor: A square sheet with one diagonal drawn, and the other diagonal faint.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks the other diagonal is parallel because it is the next diagonal.
video_script.payoff_line: Fold a corner onto the centre, and the crease is parallel to the diagonal.

final_answer.value: Fold a corner onto the centre; the crease is parallel to the diagonal
final_answer.spoken: fold a corner onto the centre, and the crease is parallel to the diagonal

hold_back: Fold a corner onto the centre; the crease is parallel to the diagonal
maths_rules: fold a corner that is not on the folded diagonal onto the centre of the sheet
the fold sends the corner straight along the other diagonal to the centre, so the crease is at right angles to the other diagonal
the diagonals of a square cross at right angles, so the first diagonal is also at right angles to the other diagonal
two lines at right angles to the same line are parallel, so the crease is parallel to the first diagonal
the slip: the other diagonal crosses the first at the centre, and lines that cross cannot be parallel
video_script.design: One square sheet stays on the stage. The corner folds onto the centre, the crease is drawn, and the two right angle marks on the other diagonal show the reason.
